name: K-W3b
description: Wave W3, light: lamp scatter luminance against sigma (start lamp), camera frost coverage and chain order (start frost), the aurora shell's state (start model) and the aurora in the real sky (start aurora), surface cover (start cover) and the sea ice (start ice, a capsule afloat on the sea through -redefinitionProbeSea, which the near-ground rows need). Every start flies the launch-pad vessel of the probe save and runs exactly one probe, because the first probe that finishes ends the game. The shader bundle is built before the run.

starts.description: lamp scatter (D32): forced snow field, beam geometry, lamp off control, DLSS turn
camera frost (D37): shader and atlas, chain order, exposure growth, IVA A/B
aurora state (D38): shader, Auto rules, body rule, pole axis
aurora in the real sky with the full mod set (Scatterer, EVE, TUFX, Parallax): draw order, terrain occlusion, lid / drip / band, with a picture sheet of the natural and the aid view
surface cover (D34): ground cover from the field, vehicle shells, tracks, orbit overlay host, switch cycle; needs a rover (wheels) on the ground

sea ice (D35): shaders, hash and noise values, coverage against the field, orbit picture, near-ground sheet at 50 m, 500 m and 5 km, switch cycle; the capsule is afloat on the home body's sea (-redefinitionProbeSea)
